import sys, time, random, json, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from utils import run_experiment

def bench(case):
    start=time.process_time();r=run_experiment(case)
    print('events',len(case['events']),'cpu',time.process_time()-start,'rss_kb',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'output_len',len(json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':'))),flush=True)
    return r

cfg={'banks':1,'load_balancers':1,'fifo_bytes':2147483647,'pifo_bytes':2147483647,
    'refill_batch':32,'sample_period':100000,'borders':[0,2147483647],
    'policy':{'kind':'sff'},'events':[]}
mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'refill'
rng=random.Random(735)
if mode=='refill':
    ids=list(range(60000));rng.shuffle(ids)
    cfg['events']=[['enqueue',id,0,1,id] for id in ids]+[['save',0]]
    for i in range(19999):cfg['events'] += [['dequeue',1],['restore',0]]
elif mode=='branch':
    cfg['events']=[['enqueue',i,0,1,rng.randrange(2147483647)] for i in range(40000)]+[['save',0]]
    for j in range(1,64):
        cfg['events'] += [['restore',0]]+[['dequeue',1] for _ in range(900)]+[['save',j]]
elif mode=='cancel':
    cfg['events']=[['enqueue',i,0,1,rng.randrange(2147483647)] for i in range(60000)]+[['save',0]]
    for i in range(19999):cfg['events'] += [['cancel',rng.randrange(60000)],['restore',0]]
elif mode=='dequeue':
    cfg['events']=[['enqueue',i,0,1,rng.randrange(2147483647)] for i in range(60000)]+[['dequeue',40000]]
elif mode=='wfq':
    cfg['policy']={'kind':'wfq','weights':[[i,rng.randrange(1,1025)] for i in range(10000)]}
    cfg['events']=[['enqueue',i,i%10000,1000000,0] for i in range(60000)]+[['save',0]]
    for i in range(19999):cfg['events'] += [['weight',i%10000,i%1024+1],['restore',0]]
bench(cfg)
PY
